author: PR32 team16 Role4 independent validation (claude-opus-5.5 max)
purpose: Single bounded CPU witness for candidate finding F1: the frozen caller drain() success predicate requires current_admitted_cost == 0 exactly (caller lines 17 and 109), while gateway arithmetic adds on admission (gateway 456, 467) and subtracts with max(0.0, current - cost) on finish (gateway 518-521) with no reset at idle, and /metrics returns dict(state) unrounded (gateway 388-392, 928-930).

parts.P1_arithmetic_replica: SYNTHETIC literal costs only. Replica of gateway lines 456/467 (cur + cost) and 518-521 (max(0.0, cur - cost)). Cases: costs (0.1, 0.2) admitted together then finished FIFO and LIFO; five synthetic formula-form costs max(0.1, 0.259 + 0.000758*i + 0.0052083333*o) for literal (i, o) pairs admitted together and finished in all 120 orders; all 10 pairs FIFO and LIFO; sequential non-overlap control. The formula form is an illustration, not a claim about actual request costs or Train inputs.
parts.P2_frozen_drain: Import the frozen caller from the worktree (hash verified before and after) and await its drain() with an httpx.MockTransport client (no sockets). Case residue: /metrics returns current_in_flight 0, current_waiting 0, tokenizer_fallback_requests 0 and current_admitted_cost equal to the P1 (0.1, 0.2) FIFO residue. Control zero: identical with current_admitted_cost 0.0. Owner stub: deadline = now + 0.6 s, reserve = 0.1 s, check() no-op. Evidence files go to a fresh witness01-out subdirectory of this capsule.
parts.P3_hypothetical_predicate: Evaluate, on the recorded P2 readings only, the proposed predicate in_flight == 0 and waiting == 0 and fallback == 0 and abs(cost) <= 1e-9. Hypothetical; no source is modified.

hypothesis_H1: P1 yields a strictly positive residue for at least one overlapping order; P2 residue case raises ProbeError('original work deadline exhausted') after >= 2 readings whose counters are all 0 and whose cost equals the residue, and records no caller_drains entry; P2 zero control returns after exactly 1 reading with caller_drains[final].drained True.

interpretation.CONFIRMED (exit 0): F1 holds: the frozen drain treats an idle gateway with positive float residue as busy until the original work deadline, so a valid run can end NOT_RUN (pre-episode) or FAILED (final) and spill one evidence file per reading.
interpretation.REFUTED (exit 3): F1 is withdrawn; any mismatch is reported verbatim.
interpretation.ERROR (other nonzero): Witness defect; reported, not interpreted as caller evidence.

bounds: One execution per interpreter (Python 3.14.4 and 3.12.16), timeout 60 s each, nice -n19, single-thread env, -B -I, PYTHONPATH unset, no bytecode, no network, no GPU, no Git, no Train/Eval data, no source edits. Failures and outputs are retained.
non_claims: CPU/mock witness only; says nothing about actual gateway traffic overlap in the frozen Train probes, Native qualification, MPC benefit or performance.
